newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Controls valve plant evacuated.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Controls valve plant evacuated.

text.p: A Johnson Controls Inc foundry was evacuated Wednesday after a small electrical fire shut down the cooling system for the plant's furnaces, a spokesman said.
Roughly 300 workers were evacuated because the shutdown could have caused piping to melt that might have touched off a steam explosion, the spokesman said. No one was injured.
The cause of the fire in an electrical panel was not known.
The plant makes brass valves used in automated heating and cooling systems for commercial buildings. Production was expected to resume shortly.
